copy.lead: Every number here is what happened, copied, summed or re-weighted. Descriptive: not a forecast.
copy.plus_scale: 100 is the average qualified player of each board, not the average club. The league's own weighted mean of each rollup sits beside it.
copy.basis_roster: Club today: the rollups the Hitters, Starters, Bullpen and Defense team tabs serve, copied unchanged. A traded player's whole season counts for the club that holds him now.
copy.basis_earned: Earned: each player's season index weighted by the plate appearances or innings he took for each club, split by his Baseball-Reference stint rows. It re-weights the served per-player values and scores nothing new.
copy.past_seasons: Past seasons show the earned basis only: a club-today rollup of a past season would put its players under the clubs that hold them now.
copy.xwl: xW-L is MLB's published expected record (xWinLoss) over the games played.
copy.w_minus_xw: W - xW is the gap between the record and the record the runs imply. It describes the games played and nothing else.
copy.pitches: Pitch counts are what each club earned: lineup P/PA over every plate appearance it took, pitchers' bats included; rotation and bullpen P/IP from MLB's starter and reliever splits, innings counted as outs / 3. Team PAR is 100 x a club's rate over the mean of the thirty club rates, so the clubs average 100 and 110 is 10 percent more pitches. Rotation IP/GS is innings thrown in starts per start.
copy.depth: Heart 3 is the mean HEM+ of the club's top three qualified hitters; Rest is the PA-weighted HEM+ of its other hitters; the gap is Heart 3 minus Rest. Same rows and club basis as Offense+ (club today).
copy.coverage: Swingmen and arms under the board floors sit in neither Rotation+ nor Bullpen+, and hitters with no HEM+ sit outside Offense+.

tendencies.style_sentence: Style, not skill: each is a signed z-score across the thirty club-seasons of its season, sign as measured. Not an index, no ladder, no plus sign; a frequency has no good direction, and these repeat because they are policy.
tendencies.columns_are_realized_not_skill: Realized value, not skill. Each figure is the win probability that actually moved after the decision, credited to the club that made it, from the decision to the last play it governed. What the alternative would have produced, the reliever not used, the batter not lifted, the pitch not thrown, is not observed, so this is a record of what happened after a manager acted and not a measure of how well he chose. A reliever who pitched well after a poor choice and a hitter who homered after a bad matchup are both in these numbers.
tendencies.agent_sentence: The agent is the club-season until the manager ledger lands; a club that changed managers during a season is one row here and two in reality.
tendencies.sort_by_realized_is_a_rank_by_what_happe: sorting a realized column ranks club-seasons by what happened after their decisions, not by how well they chose
tendencies.running_columns_are_style_not_skill: attempts, success rate and target mix are what a club chose to do; they repeat because running is a policy. Summed decision value is withheld.
tendencies.why_no_plus_metric: the gate battery found a club's decision value in this family does not repeat between halves of a season, so a plus metric on it would be a ranking of noise. The leverage board withholds its own for the same reason.
